mission.title: The Device
mission.description: Find the missing component for the Effectuator's Device.

phase.briefing:
With all this talk of missing floors, stairs that end, it all seems to point to one thing: a construct. Wouldn't you agree? Oh, my apologies; I completely forgot how too much thinking makes your head hurt.
Anyhow, assuming that we're dealing with a construct, we must turn to the Effectuator. He can delve into all of the, ah... technical issues that I wouldn't bother with.

talk.say:
Ah, {player}. What a pleasant surprise! Come for some trip planning advice? No?
Oh, I see. Yes, it would seem that this whole Anome situation falls right up my alley, wouldn't it? Maybe I could help... but what...
Of course! The Device! I really just call it that until I get a real name for it, something fancy thought up by the eggheads. The Device would be just the thing for this predicament!
There's only one problem... the Device isn't actually complete. It needs just one component, one little teensy tiny bit, from, say... another version of the simulation.
I'm sending the pertinent data to your operator. Flood should know who can get that for you. And if he doesn't, he should be fired.

done.say: Have fun, and bring me whatever you "dig" up! Oh, I'm just too bad.

phase.briefing:
Oh, the Effectuator thinks he's so clever! That prancing fool! Of course I know to go to... ah...
Digger! I mean, Digger, of course. Any idiot can see that. Let's see... D... D... Digger. There we go. He'll be expecting you.

enter.say: You should find Digger in here. Pay attention... he has a wealth of knowledge regarding the past instances of the simulation.

talk.say:
Hey, kid. You look rushed. You want to sit down, have a drink? I've got this chunk of data and I think it's from the original...
No? I figured as much. Flood filled me in on the plan. I'd love to help, but there's one snag. The component the Effectuator needs, it's not an easy thing to come by. I have part, but I don't have the data key to unlock it. I do know where to find one, though. The Crushers have put their hands on what we need, and they're looking to make someone break the bank to buy it.
That's where you come in. I know how Flood works, with his "budget". Funny how much mimosas seem to cost these days.
So, you're gonna have to do some... bargain hunting. Got it? Just get that data key and bring it to me, and I'll get you set up with the component.

done.say: I'll get the stuff ready on my end for when you come back with that key. Oh... and don't expect it to look like a key, okay? I'm sure you know that already.

phase.briefing: I don't know what the Crushers are doing around here, and quite frankly, I don't care. Just get that key from them.

enter.say: I'll monitor the code stream for that key while you take care of the bad guys.

done.say: That book! That's the key. Grab it and get out of there.

phase.briefing: Well that wasn't so hard, now was it? I've given you Digger's location; give him the key, or book, or whatever it is you have, and get whatever it is the prancing idiot wants, and... Oh, just do whatever it is. I can't be bothered with details.

enter.say: Give the key to Digger and he should be able to get us the component.

objective.text: Give the data key to Digger

done.say: Nice, very nice. Now I should be able to... yep. Check out that computer over there. Should be a disk in it. Grab that, and you're good to go.

objective.text: Get the disk from the computer

done.say: So... you tell Flood that if this came in helpful, someday he should set up a meeting with me and the Effectuator. I'd love to pick his brains.

phase.briefing: I assume you know what to do now, as I'm really just too bored to give you any instructions.

enter.say:
Geez, Flood's really getting lazy.
The Effectuator should be in here, just waiting for the component on that disk.

objective.text: Give the disk to the Effectuator

talk.say: Ah, my friend. Is that a component in your pocket, or... Ha! Oh, my.

done.say:
Fantastico! I'll get right to work on my Device. I'll finally be able to see it in action!
And you, my friend, deserve a siesta!

mission.finish:
Hmm? What? Oh, good, it's done. Thank god; I was about to fall asleep.
Good work, blah blah, whatever. We'll be in touch.
